guess_char_d: Four buttons — pick the right name
chain_d: Difficulty rises with each correct answer
duel_slash: ⚔️ A **duel** needs an opponent: use **`/duel @member`** (rounds + difficulty). You can also type **`!duel`**.
dispatch_err: ❌ Error starting the mini-game. Retry or use the command directly.
gy_desc:
What year did **{title}** start airing?
Answer with a year (e.g. `2015`).
gy_footer_list: Anime picked from your AniList (completed, watching, repeating, paused).
gy_footer_fb: AniList list empty or no known year — global pick.
gy_win: ✅ Correct! The year was **{year}** (you said {guess}). You earn 8 XP!
gy_err: ❌ Something went wrong or time ran out.
ge_desc:
How many episodes does **{title}** have?
Answer with a number (e.g. `24`).
ge_footer_list: Anime from your AniList (completed, watching, repeating, paused).
ge_footer_fb: AniList list empty or no fixed episode count — global pick.
ge_win: ✅ Nice! **{title}** has {ep} episodes (you said {guess}). You earn 8 XP!
ge_badnum: ❌ Not a valid number. **{title}** has **{ep}** episodes.
gg_desc:
Name one genre of **{title}**.
Answer with an AniList-style genre (e.g. `Psychological`, `Slice of Life`).
**Very common** genres (Action, Comedy, Romance, Fantasy…) are valid, but **repeating the same word** over and over triggers **warnings then penalties**.
{hint}
gg_tip: Tip: mix it up — a rarer or more specific genre avoids “easy” warnings.
gg_footer_list: Anime from your AniList (completed, watching, repeating, paused).
gg_footer_fb: AniList list empty, private, or no usable genres — global pick.
gg_hard:
🚨 **Last warning** for **{guess}**: one more repeat = **penalty** (−XP, long cooldown, see `/profile`). Really mix it up.
{hint}
gg_pen_ok:
✅ **{guess}** was correct, but **anti-spam**: too many repeats of the same “easy” genre in ~5 min.
**{xp} XP** · cooldown **{cd}s** (level **{strike}**) · penalties: **{total}** (see `/profile`).
Genres for **{title}**: {genres}.
gg_pen_bad:
❌ **{guess}** isn’t among **{title}**’s genres.
**Anti-spam**: same “easy” genre repeated **{n}×** in ~5 min.
**{xp} XP** · cooldown **{cd}s** (level **{strike}**) · penalties: **{total}** (see `/profile`).
Genres were: {genres}.
gg_spam2: ⚠️ {mention} — **2** correct answers in a row with an “easy” genre. Keep that up and you risk a **penalty**; vary your genres.
gg_spam3: 🚨 **Last warning** (easy-genre streak): one more slip = **penalty** (−XP + cooldown).
gg_spam_pen:
✅ **{guess}** was correct, but **anti-spam**: too many “easy” answers in a row or within 5 min.
**{xp} XP** · cooldown **{cd}s** (level **{strike}**) · penalties: **{total}** (see `/profile`).
Genres for **{title}**: {genres}.
gg_exact: ✅ Correct! **{title}**’s genres include {genres}. You earn 5 XP!
gc_desc: Click the button with the correct name.
gc_footer_list: Four different anime from your AniList; one image = the right character.
gc_footer_fb: AniList list empty or unavailable — global pick (popularity).
gc_win: ✅ Nice **{user}**! It was **{name}** *(**{anime}**)*. You earn **+5 XP**.
hub_desc:
**Two menus**: **Guessing** and **Others** — the game **starts** in this channel as soon as you pick.
• **Duel**: reminder — use **`/duel @member`** (no auto game from the menu).

Shortcuts: **`/guessyear`**, **`/guessepisodes`**, **`/guessgenre`**, **`/guesscharacter`**, **`/guesswho`**, **`/chainquiz`**, **`/higherlower`**, **`/guessop`**, **`/animequiz`**, **`/animequizmulti`**. Raid boss: **`/raidconfig`** (admin).
